description: This is a Java interface defining data access object (DAO) methods for person-related database operations in the OpenMRS project. It includes method signatures for retrieving, saving, and deleting Person, Relationship, PersonName, PersonAddress, and related entities, as well as handling merge logs. The interface is used by the PersonService to abstract database interactions concerning person data.

classes.name: PersonDAO
classes.description: Interface defining the data access layer for person-related entities in the OpenMRS system, including methods for CRUD operations on Person, Relationship, PersonName, PersonAddress, and merge logs.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople
methods.description: Retrieves a set of persons similar to the given name, birth year, and gender, potentially for deduplication or suggestion purposes.

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Fetches a list of Person objects matching the search phrase, with options to filter by 'dead' and 'voided' statuses.

methods.name: savePerson
methods.description: Persists a Person entity to the database, used for creating or updating person records.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a given Person record from the database.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Retrieves a Person based on their unique ID.

methods.name: saveRelationship
methods.description: Saves or updates a Relationship entity.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Fetches relationships involving specified persons, optionally filtered by relationship type and effective dates.

methods.name: saveRelationshipType
methods.description: Persists a RelationshipType to the database.

methods.name: deleteRelationshipType
methods.description: Deletes a RelationshipType from the database.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getPerson/Person by UUID
methods.description: Retrieve Person or related entities using their UUIDs for unique identification.
